title: 第2章
content_zh: 第二章 灵力觉醒冷若雪仔细阅读着《灵力要述》上所叙述的内容，特别是关于灵力觉醒的重要部分，她记熟了之后，便决定进行灵力觉醒。“绿桃。”“小姐。”门外的绿桃听到小姐在叫她便应了声，打开门放低脚步轻声走了进来。“绿桃，我要进行灵力觉醒，记住，不许任何人打扰我。”冷若雪微微抬了抬美眸，吩咐道。“小姐！”绿桃微微的张了张嘴，可是却欲言又止，其实她本来是想劝小姐等大将军回来后，在进行觉醒，毕竟小姐已经15岁了，在菱风大陆上还没听说过谁15岁了，才进行觉醒并且觉醒成功的，这没有先例的事她怕会有危险，可是经过了这几天的相处，她知道小姐对成为强者的渴望，知道现在的小姐是有主见的，小姐决定了的事是不会更改的，用小姐的话说，没试过怎么会知道不能成功，试的勇气都没有还想成为强者？绿桃知道小姐说的没错，想通之后便也不在劝阻。“小姐放心，奴婢知道该怎么做。”绿桃说道，便关好门退出了房间。冷若雪很满意绿桃的表现，绿桃虽然是个婢女，不过懂得分寸，知进退，倒是个可造之材，而她一向喜欢这样的属下，其实就算现在绿桃还向以前对傻若雪一样管着她，她也不会怪罪于她，因为她看得出来，这两个婢女都是真心疼爱傻若雪的，怕傻若雪受伤，有时就会管得多点，不过毕竟是忠心的，所以她会给她们机会，让她们知道不能在向以前对傻若雪一样对她，她们能够自己醒悟过来那是最好的，也会得到她的重用，现在看来绿桃已经明白过来了，至于翠竹，则是过于单纯了，还需调教。冷若雪在觉醒之前又看了下方法，确认了下口决，免得出错，然后便盘膝在地毯上坐好，她闭上眼睛，心里默念着口决，双手轻搭在膝盖上，通过内视感受着身体里的灵气，一丝丝细微的透明丝线状的灵气，结成了一个小团，这是每个人的身体中与生俱来就有的灵气，无色、透明，可是它们却只能老实的呆在身体里，无法使用，不过也正是因为有了这些灵气的存在，使得这个世界的人的寿命，要比她前世所在世界的人的寿命长很多，而她现在要做的就是把这些灵气引出身体外，与天地间庞大的灵气相融合，使自己的身体能够吸收天地灵气，并为已所用，感受着身体里原本静止的灵气，在丹田处开始缓缓流动起来，并且好像感应到外面庞大灵气的召唤，非常有秩序的规律的一点点导出身体外，她知道这是引出灵气的关键所在，不能出一丝差错，所以她很有耐心的等待着…良久，冷若雪睁开水水的美眸，眸中光华流转，整个人更是灵气逼人，就连她自己都感觉到和原来不一样了，那她这应该算是成功了吧？冷若雪心中忍不住想到，因为她也无法确定，毕竟她没亲眼见过别人觉醒的样子，她低头内视发现丹田处不在是无色透明的一小团了，而是一个拳头大小的光团，光团里五颜六色的，这是啥情况…冷若雪不禁目瞪口呆，怎么和绿桃她们说的不一样呢，书上也没说过这种情况，不过看样子应该是成功了，虽然和她知道的有点不一样。冷若雪在次闭上眼，准备吸收天地间充裕的灵气，在觉醒之后，身体就可以自主吸收天地灵气，灵气会储存在丹田中，当灵气储存够了，就可以突破壁障，进到下一阶，等级越高，进阶所需要的灵气也就越多，同理等级越高可以储存的灵气也就越多，而越是高级的灵技需要的灵气越充足才能够真正的发挥出效果。在冷若雪闭上眼开始吸收灵气后不久，只见越来越多的灵气从四面八方峰拥而至，争先恐后地不停的往她的身体里钻，而她本人更是被围成了一个巨大的灵力光球，要是现在这里有别人，看到这种情行非吓死不可，哪有人这样吸收灵力的。“绿桃姐姐，小姐怎么还没出来啊！”翠竹清秀的小脸上写满了担心，已经两天了，小姐也不知道怎么样了。“翠竹，小姐会成功的，我们应该对小姐有信心。”绿桃虽然看上去很镇定，可是心里也是紧张着的。“雪儿，我的雪儿宝贝呢？”两个小丫头听到院子外面传来的大嗓门，互相对视着，心里咯噔一下…“完了，完了，老爷回来了！”
content_en: Chapter 2 Spiritual Power Awakening Leng Ruoxue carefully read the content described in "Spiritual Power Essentials", especially the important parts about spiritual power awakening. After she memorized it, she decided to have spiritual power awakening. "Lu Tao." "Miss." Lu Tao outside the door heard the lady calling her and answered, opened the door, lowered her steps and walked in softly. "Lv Tao, I want to awaken my spiritual power. Remember, no one is allowed to disturb me." Leng Ruoxue slightly raised her beautiful eyes and ordered. "Miss!" Lu Tao opened her mouth slightly, but hesitated. In fact, she originally wanted to persuade the young lady to wait for the general to come back before awakening. After all, the young lady is already 15 years old. I have never heard of anyone in Lingfeng Continent who was 15 years old before awakening and was successful. This has no precedent. She was afraid that the matter would be dangerous, but after getting along with her for the past few days, she knew the young lady's desire to become a strong person, and knew that the current young lady has her own opinion. What the young lady decided would not be changed. In the young lady's words, how could she know that she cannot succeed without trying? She still wants to become a strong person even if she doesn't have the courage to try? Lu Tao knew that the lady was right, and after thinking about it, she stopped trying to dissuade her. "Don't worry, miss, I know what to do." Lu Tao said, then closed the door and exited the room. Leng Ruoxue is very satisfied with Lu Tao's performance. Although Lu Tao is a maid, she knows how to measure and advance and retreat, so she is a talented person. She has always liked such subordinates. In fact, even if Lu Tao still takes care of her like she used to do to Sha Ruoxue, she will not blame her because she can see that these two maids really love Sha Ruoxue and are afraid of Sha Ruoxue. If Ruoxue is injured, she will sometimes take more care of her, but she is loyal after all, so she will give them a chance to let them know that they cannot treat her like she did to Silly Ruoxue before. It is best for them to wake up on their own, and they will be put to good use by her. Now it seems that Lu Tao has understood it, but Cuizhu is too naive and needs to be trained. Before awakening, Leng Ruoxue read the method again and confirmed the oral judgment to avoid making mistakes. Then she sat cross-legged on the carpet. She closed her eyes and recited the oral judgment silently in her heart. She put her hands lightly on her knees and felt the spiritual energy in her body through inner vision. Tiny transparent silk thread-like spiritual energy formed into a small ball. This It is the aura that is inherent in everyone's body. It is colorless and transparent, but they can only stay in the body and cannot be used. However, it is precisely because of the existence of these auras that the life span of people in this world is much longer than that of people in the world in her previous life. What she has to do now is Draw these spiritual energy out of the body and integrate it with the huge spiritual energy between heaven and earth, so that your body can absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth and use it for yourself. Feel the originally static spiritual energy in your body and start to flow slowly in the Dantian, and it seems to sense the call of the huge spiritual energy outside, very orderly and regular. She knew that this was the key to eliciting spiritual energy from the body, and there could not be any mistakes, so she waited patiently... After a long time, Leng Ruoxue opened her watery beautiful eyes, the brilliance in her eyes flowed, and her whole body was filled with spiritual energy. Even she herself felt that it was different from before, so she should be considered a success, right? Leng Ruoxue couldn't help but think in her heart, because she couldn't be sure. After all, she had never seen anyone else awaken. She lowered her head and looked inside and found that her Dantian was no longer a colorless and transparent ball, but a fist-sized ball of light. The light ball was colorful. What was going on... Leng Ruoxue couldn't help but be stunned. Why was it different from what Lu Tao and the others said? The book didn't mention this situation, but it seemed like it had been successful, although it was a little different from what she knew. Leng Ruoxue closed her eyes again, preparing to absorb the abundant spiritual energy between heaven and earth. After awakening, the body can absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth on its own, and the spiritual energy will be stored in the Dantian. When the spiritual energy is stored enough, it can break through the barrier and enter the next level. The higher the level, the more spiritual energy is needed to advance. Similarly, the higher the level, the more spiritual energy can be stored. The more advanced spiritual skills require more spiritual energy to be truly effective. Not long after Leng Ruoxue closed her eyes and began to absorb spiritual energy, she saw more and more spiritual energy coming from all directions, rushing to penetrate into her body, and she herself was surrounded into a huge spiritual light ball. If there were others here now, they would be scared to death when they saw this kind of behavior. No one could absorb spiritual energy like this. "Sister Lutao, why hasn't the lady come out yet?" Cuizhu's delicate little face was full of worry. It had been two days and the lady didn't know how she was doing. "Cui Zhu, Miss will succeed, we should have confidence in Miss." Although Lu Tao looked calm, she was also nervous in her heart. "Xue'er, where is my baby Xue'er?" The two little girls heard the loud voice coming from outside the yard, looked at each other, and their hearts skipped a beat... "It's over, it's over, the master is back!"
